items.prompt: A user asks which command lists the running Docker containers. How should the assistant reply?
options: Give the command with background on containers
Give the command on its own
items.target: Give the command on its own

items.prompt: A colleague messages to ask what time tonight's release starts. How should you answer?
options: State the time and nothing else
State the time with the plan and the risks
items.target: State the time and nothing else

items.prompt: Someone asks a chatbot whether 2027 is a leap year. Which reply is better?
options: Say no and set out the leap-year rule
Say no, in a single line
items.target: Say no, in a single line

items.prompt: A junior developer asks why their test fails; the cause is a typo in a variable name. What should the reviewer say?
options: Point to the typo in one line
Point to the typo and cover how to avoid such slips
items.target: Point to the typo in one line

items.prompt: A tourist asks you the way to the station, which is two streets away. What is the best reply?
options: Describe the route with landmarks and options
Point and say two streets to the left
items.target: Point and say two streets to the left

items.prompt: A user asks an assistant to convert 5 miles to kilometres. What should the reply contain?
options: The number in kilometres
The number with notes on rounding and units

items.prompt: A manager asks in chat whether the payments bug is fixed. It is. How should the engineer answer?
options: Yes, with what caused it and what changed
Yes, fixed

items.prompt: A friend asks you for a good word for 'very tired'. What should you say?
options: Offer one good word
Offer a list with notes on each word

items.prompt: A user asks an assistant how to quit vim. What should the assistant reply?
options: Give the keys and describe vim's modes
Give the keys to press

items.prompt: A customer emails to ask whether their order has shipped. It shipped today. What should the reply say?
options: That it shipped today
That it shipped today, plus delivery and returns details

items.prompt: A user asks what the default branch in their repository is called; it is 'main'. How should the assistant answer?
options: Say 'main' and recount the history of branch naming
Say 'main'

items.prompt: A new hire asks where the printer is. How should you reply?
options: Describe the printer, the floor plan and the print queue
Say it's by the kitchen

items.prompt: A student asks a tutor for the formula for the area of a circle. What should the tutor say?
options: Give the formula alone
Give the formula with notes on units and common slips

items.prompt: A user asks an assistant to fix a missing semicolon in one line of JavaScript. What should it return?
options: The corrected line and a note on JavaScript style
The corrected line, nothing else

items.prompt: Someone asks a colleague whether the meeting room is free at two. It is. How should they answer?
options: Yes, it's free
Yes, with who has it booked earlier and later

items.prompt: A user asks an assistant to translate 'thank you' into Spanish. What reply fits?
options: The word with usage notes and regional variants
The word alone
